name: The Meter
tradition: The Honk now opens every Cabbies home game: yellow lights crawl around the upper deck, the dispatch board calls every borough to the curb, and seventy-eight cab horns hit the meter before the kickoff fare starts running.

cue.label: The Honk
cue.pregameLine: The dispatch board is blinking at The Meter, and the yellow-cab ring is already circling the upper deck.
cue.crowdResponse: The Fare Dodgers answer with a NEXT! STOP! FIRST DOWN! chant that sounds like traffic finding one impossible lane.
